name: Fairmont Ajman
positioning: Fairmont Ajman, a beachfront resort in Ajman with a private beach, an infinity pool and water sports
best_for: Families wanting a beach stay with large family rooms
Travelers who want water sports, wellness sessions and a spa by the sea

facts.text: Located on Sheikh Humaid Bin Rashid Al Nuaimi Street in Al Nakhil 2, Ajman, a short drive from Sharjah International Airport.
The hotel has an infinity pool with views of the sea.
Rooms and suites feature dark-wood accents, marble flooring and leather headboards.
The Family Room has one king bed and two double beds, with a large furnished balcony and Arabian Gulf view.
The hotel has 6 dining venues, including restaurants, lounges and bars.
Water sports include jet skiing, banana rides, kayaks, paddleboards and sailing boats.
Wellness sessions include yoga, ice baths and boot camps.
The hotel has paddle tennis courts.

highlights.text: The Signature Terrace Room has two double beds, a large private terrace with sun loungers and umbrellas, and a panoramic Gulf view.
The 3 Bedroom and 4 Bedroom Royal Penthouses include round-trip shuttle bus service to Dubai Mall.
The hotel has a private beach.
Weddings can be held at the Pearl Garden beachfront venue.
The hotel partners with Al Zorah Golf Club for golf.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes that Ajman is a smaller emirate with fewer urban attractions nearby.
